FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Ple:
SELPHY: Oh? Do I know you from somewhere?
Oh, but that doesn't matter.
I am exquisitely bored. Please, hear my wish.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Wis:
I wish to see a POKéMON. A darling {STR_VAR_1}.
I want to see one right away. Please, make my wish come true.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_OhI:
SELPHY: Oh, I'm tired of this. I'm tired of waiting for you.
I'll forgive you this time, but please don't fail me next time.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Mon:
SELPHY: Oh, hello, there.
Oh, my gracious. That must be the {STR_VAR_1} you caught for me.
Giggle… I see a resemblance to you.
Thank you so kindly.
… …  … …  … … Is something the matter?
You may leave.
… …  … …  … … Oh, fine. I understand now.
SEBASTIAN! I need you here this instant!
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Sel: SELPHY: See to it that this person is given a token of appreciation.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_But: Butler: I shall do as you bid, my lady.

Butler: I sincerely thank you for pleasing Lady SELPHY.
Please accept this as her thanks…
Butler: Your BAG appears to be unfortunately full.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Sel: SELPHY: I wish you the best of luck.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Lad:
Butler: The smile of Lady SELPHY has the brilliance of the sun.
Please, I beg you to bring joy to Lady SELPHY.
